name: Mi'cha
description: A man who threw a drunken soldier over ten meters.

description_citations.text: Fourth Edition: card flavor text (Fourth Edition, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mi'cha throws a drunken soldier over ten meters before the blow lands.
timeline.quote: His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.
